tools.name: Search
tools.description:
Search the user's Glean enterprise index and return ranked results.

Results are permission-filtered to the authorized user. Use 'offset' with
'limit' to page; 'has_next_page' indicates more results remain. Offset
paging is supported up to roughly 2000 results (20 pages x 100 items);
deeper offsets raise an error rather than return a misleading empty page.
When the fetch budget is exhausted before the requested window is filled,
the tool raises rather than return a partial page (fail loud over mislead).
The result list is trimmed to a size budget when items are large;
'truncated' flags it and 'has_next_page' stays true so the caller can page
or narrow the query.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Natural-language search query to run against the user's Glean index.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0-indexed position of the first result to return. Defaults to 0 (first result).

output.description: Ranked Glean results plus pagination metadata. 'has_next_page' is true when more results are available (page with a larger 'offset'); 'truncated' is true when the result list was trimmed to fit a response-size budget.

summary:
## Glean Toolkit

Arcade toolkit that exposes the Glean Client API, enabling search over a company's Glean enterprise index with results permission-filtered to the authenticated user.

## Capabilities

- **Enterprise search:** Query the Glean index and retrieve ranked, permission-filtered results scoped to the authorized user.
- **Pagination:** Page through results using `offset` and `limit`; `has_next_page` signals additional pages. Offset paging is supported up to ~2 000 results (e.g. 20 pages × 100 items); deeper offsets raise an error instead of returning a misleading empty page.
- **Result trimming and transparency:** When the fetch budget is exhausted before the requested window is filled, or when result items are large and the list is trimmed to a size budget, the tool raises or sets `truncated: true` and keeps `has_next_page: true` — failing loud rather than silently returning incomplete data.

## OAuth

Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 via the **Glean** provider. Users must authorize through Glean's OAuth flow before searches are executed on their behalf.

## Secrets

- **`GLEAN_API_URL`** — The base URL for your organization's Glean Client API endpoint (e.g. `https://<your-tenant>-be.glean.com`). This is tenant-specific and can be found in your Glean admin or developer settings. Refer to your Glean workspace administrator or the [Glean developer documentation](https://developers.glean.com/docs/client_api/client_api_overview/) to locate the correct endpoint for your deployment.

See the [Arcade secrets guide](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets) for how to configure secrets, and manage them at [https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
